name: Pulmonary arterial hypertension clinical benchmarks (tertiary center)
description: Development of clinical performance benchmarks for diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension in a tertiary academic medical center.
evaluation_method: clinical performance metrics (sensitivity, specificity, AUC) and rate-based quality metrics (guideline-adherence rates, time-to-treatment, outcome rates)
general_score_metric: AUC for diagnostic models and guideline-adherence rates / outcome rates for process benchmarks
reputation: A single-center, clinically focused benchmark used for internal quality improvement and academic reporting with limited external adoption.
notes: Single tertiary-center dataset with limited generalizability; small sample sizes for rare conditions, potential confounding and selection biases; not designed for LLM evaluation.
